tiers.name: Junior Apex
tiers.home: a home pole barn and lean-to
tiers.rig: a used F-150 and an open trailer
tiers.bottleneck: travel gas, chains and tire wear

tech.name: Carburetor blueprinting
tech.desc: Hand-matched jets and venturis. More top speed, but the motor runs a little hotter, so it costs grip to keep it cool.

tech.name: Sprocket gearing
tech.desc: A tighter sprocket for quicker drive off the corners, at the price of top speed on the long straights.

tech.name: Clutch tuning
tech.desc: A lighter clutch launches you cleaner from the green, and holds up better on a dirt start.

tech.name: Lightened frame
tech.desc: Drill and trim the chassis tubes. Quicker to turn in, and cheaper to repair, but it flexes more under a hard hit.

tech.name: Shock valving
tech.desc: Valve your own shocks for a car that keeps its bite as the dirt goes slick, and slides more predictably.

tech.name: Tire siping lab
tech.desc: Groove the tread so it bites when the track goes slick. Wears a little faster.

tech.name: Track bar
tech.desc: Set the rear end to sit square through the turns, so the car rotates on command.

tech.name: Radiator package
tech.desc: Keep the engine cool through a long dirt main. More power, but the motor works harder in the heat.

tiers.name: Short Track
tiers.bottleneck: front clip collision repair and tire sets

tech.name: Tire stagger
tech.desc: Run a bigger right rear, so the car turns left more eagerly. Great on an oval, but it pushes on a road course.

tech.name: Sway bar
tech.desc: A stiffer front bar sharpens turn-in, at the cost of some grip when the car is loaded up on entry.

tech.name: Rear end gears
tech.desc: A quicker rear gear gives the drive off the corners, and a little less top speed.

tech.name: Chassis setup kit
tech.desc: Shim and square the chassis on the jig. Less grip lost in a slide, and repairs take less time to get right.

tiers.name: Regional Feeder
tiers.bottleneck: leased spec motors and wind tunnel bills

tech.name: Wing package
tech.desc: Adjustable wings that pin the car in fast corners. Downforce costs top speed on the straights.

tech.name: Spec motor tune
tech.desc: Get every horsepower the spec motor rules allow. Quicker everywhere, but a touch less reliable.

tech.name: Nose and splitter
tech.desc: Sculpted nose and splitter. Holds the front end down under braking.

tech.name: Quick-change rear end
tech.desc: A rear end you can change in the pits. Faster stops, and sharper drive out of the corners.

tech.name: Pit crew drills
tech.desc: Your crew practices every stop until they are quick. Shorter pit stops, every race.

tech.name: Durability package
tech.desc: Stronger parts for the long haul. Less damage from every hit, and lower repair bills.

tech.name: Fuel and tire strategy
tech.desc: Plan the stops with the data. Tires that last longer through a full race.

tech.name: Transporter upgrade
tech.desc: A bigger transporter with a better shop. Travel costs less, and repairs go faster.

tiers.name: Apex Cup
tiers.bottleneck: charter franchise debt and live telemetry

tech.name: Live telemetry
tech.desc: Data from every sensor on the car. Your crew chief sees the ideal setup sooner.

tech.name: Full wind tunnel
tech.desc: Your own full-scale tunnel. Low drag on the straights, and downforce where the corners need it.

tech.name: CFD simulation
tech.desc: Computer airflow modeling for downforce where it counts.

tech.name: Engine dyno cells
tech.desc: Run engines for days to find power and reliability.
